column1: # Closed but unmerged pull requests in the linux-surface org (human authors; 45 bot PRs left out). Snapshot 2026-11-13.
# Source: GitHub search is:pr is:closed is:unmerged per repo, each PR page read for the closing comments, PR heads fetched
#   with git (refs/pull/*/head) and compared with every patches/ dir on master (tools/closed_pr_novel.py) and with mainline v7.4-rc3.
# outcome: integrated (applied by hand or via linux-surface/kernel) | moved (resubmitted to the right repo) | superseded-upstream |
#   superseded-pr | superseded-maintainer | superseded-automation | duplicate | rejected | rejected-better-place | withdrawn |
#   abandoned | obsolete | partly-integrated | partly-integrated-rest-orphaned | promised-never-resubmitted | withdrawn-promised-followup | resubmitted
# sp9: direct | sibling | none. Orphaned code worth keeping: orphaned-patches/.

column9: note

contacts/tracking: Retain lost contacts for a few frames (fixes iptsd#226, SP8 swipes broken when a contact is missed for one frame). Author: will resubmit after more testing; never did. Rebases cleanly on master 9c7a554 (git am -3); saved in orphaned-patches/. Same ITHC/iptsd path as SP9.

Linux 7.0 series for SP9. Author: will resubmit once everything works; no later PR exists. Only novel piece worth keeping: 'drivers/hid/ithc: Fix PM suspend/resume to preserve hid_device across s2idle' (keeps struct ithc and the hid_device across suspend instead of devres_release_group, to stop iptsd holding /dev/hidraw from deadlocking on wake). Saved in orphaned-patches/; applies to v7.3-surface ITHC (dry run). Rest is AI-assisted build churn (pci-me, quickspi, int3472 edits).
apds9960 MSHW0184: ACPI ID applied (23b180c, also upstream); proximity near_level attribute: maintainer invited a new PR, none came. SB3/SL3/SP7 only.
SAM: reconfigure GPIO interrupt on probe (AMD SL4 wake power draw). Author agreed it is a hack and would raise it with the GPIO maintainers; no follow-up found.
IPTS unkillable iptsd during suspend; reopened as kernel#188 'IPTS sleep improvements' (open). IPTS (MEI) devices, not SP9.
SP10 cameras on 7.0 (IMX681, int3472 GPIO 0x08/0x10, ov13858 reset GPIO); continued as #2156 (open). int3472 POWER1 and DOVDD are now in mainline v7.4.
